verdict.rationale: The registry's business page links a "Mass change registered agent (PDF)" form. That implies registered agents are a recognized third-party role, including commercial agents acting across many entities, which is one of the rails the story names. The evidence is only a single link title, with no documentation of how agents or other designees are appointed, what they are authorized to do, or how they file on a company's behalf. missing for 10: documentation of registered-agent appointment and scope of authority, any designee or authorized-filer/representative mechanism for online filings, provider authorization rules, independent or hands-on corroboration.
